description: Shallow-PATCH a node's metadata. Each key in `patch` overwrites the same key in node.metadata; null value deletes that key. Unlisted keys are preserved. Returns the final metadata object.

expectedRevision.description: Revision from your last getRoadmap/getNode read. If the roadmap changed since, the write fails with stale_write instead of clobbering.

name: updateNodeMetadata
title: Patch a RoadRaven node's metadata (shallow merge)
